utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still lining up donations, and somebody said the hardware store’s matching the first batch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, is that actually confirmed, or just talk?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: From what I heard, yeah, it sounds confirmed enough that folks are acting on it. I’d still call the store to double-check before counting on it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive. Tell me what you need and I’ll repeat it around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure, I can do that. Just point me to the drive and I’ll start spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll repeat the details around and keep an ear out for anyone who needs the repair drive info.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just some basic tools and a bit of elbow room should do it. Thanks, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll grab the basic tools and make sure there’s room to work.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you tell me where the repair drive needs support.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The repair drive still needs hands and a few supplies. I can keep track if you tell me what gets used.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can keep track. Tell me what supplies get used, and I’ll note what still needs to be covered.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup if you still need me. What's left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Just a few small fixes now: a bike brake tune-up, one lamp bulb, and a loose chair leg. I can pass your help along for after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, please pass it along. I can take the bike brake tune-up after pickup, and the bulb and chair leg can be handled too if needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing and I’ll help line it up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s the porch light and maybe the kitchen faucet, but I’m a bit fuzzy on the second one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No need to guess on the faucet yet. If you can check it, just tell me whether it’s dripping or leaking under the sink.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by this afternoon if you can - we’re getting a few neighbors together for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can try, but I may be tied up until later this afternoon. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Around 3:30 should work if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I’m only catching bits and pieces. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s moving along. I can send you the latest repair list and the signup details if you want to help out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please send me both so I can see where to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I just want to make sure I have the details right before I help. What exactly needs repairing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We need to fix the roof over the community hall, patch the front steps, and get the broken tools in the shed working again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. So I should focus on the roof over the community hall, the front steps, and the broken tools in the shed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help however I can, but I need to keep this quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it. I’ll keep it quiet and stay in touch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my drill and a couple screwdrivers for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, can you also bring some screws and a tape measure?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, I can bring those too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to head over. Which lot is the repair drive at?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: It’s at the north lot by the old school. I’ll meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, I’ll meet you at the north lot by the old school.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a spare drill and a ladder if you need them for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. That’ll help a lot. I’ll let you know what else we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Anytime, Rey. Just tell me what’s next and I’ll bring whatever else we can use.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know how the repair drive is being organized and when it starts. I don't want to miss the timing or the pickup details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking, is the repair drive starting this Saturday, and where do we pick up the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, if it’s this Saturday, I just need the pickup spot and what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m on it, Mara. Tell me which part of the repair drive needs the most hands first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The first hands should go to the leaking roof by the west hall; if we get that patched, the rest can wait.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll round up people for the west hall roof first, then we can move the rest of the crew to the next repair.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the tarps and a box of screws. Tell Dane I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m in too. I’ll bring my drill and swing by late.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Dane. I’ll see you late with the drill—thanks for jumping in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s picking up steam again, so folks should check the sign-up sheet by the mailboxes if they want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the sheet after I pick up the kids this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — the sheet’s right by the mailboxes, and if you’re free after that, I’m sure they could use another hand.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo. I’ll get the list together and let you know what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, I’ll take care of what I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Leo, I can help with the repair drive. Just tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, tell me which part of the drive needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think the front of the drive by the garage is the part that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’ve got the repair drive on my radar already. Come by and I’ll make sure you hear about the details first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll stop by so I can hear the details firsthand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, I’ll be expecting you. I’ll fill you in as soon as you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check that for you, Eli. Tell me which location on the repair drive you mean.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The one by the east gate, if you please.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I know the place by the east gate. I’ll check it and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How much do you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet; I should check the latest amount before I say. How much is still left?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t know the exact number yet, so I’m waiting for the latest total.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is moving along, and I can check in on what still needs doing while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that’d be a big help. I think the door latch was still sticking, but I might be mixing that up with the screen.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can check the latch first while I’m out and ask around about the screen after that.
